text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...
Yeah, I still have a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Beating both Tama-chan and Oguri-chan
is quite tough... There's still a big gap between us~.
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's tighten things up step by step.
Let's not rush—let's tighten things up step by step, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Step by step,
that's how we've come this far, after all."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even if it's far away right now, someday for sure...♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, what should we make our first goal for next year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, I'd like to go somewhere
new together, just the two of us."
choice_data_list: Then shall we enter the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai! It's at Hanshin Racecourse, right?
I'm so looking forward to it~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It was a tough year, but I hope we can get off
to a good start next year. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's up, Oguri?
Is Creek botherin' ya that much?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She's not a threat just yet. But if she keeps growing
at this rate—Creek will be more terrifying than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Never crumbling, she calmly and steadily
brings the race together. That's the kind of Umamusume she is.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with the sudden serious face?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can't afford to space out. I need to train thoroughly. And then—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll eat until I drop in Osaka, too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So it comes down to that in the end?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the chaos around her...
Super Creek realized there was still a long road ahead.
